ModMetaData.name: Posthuman Drift: Trog Xenotype
ModMetaData.author: Xylthixlm
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Trog xenotype and associated genes.
Trogs are the lurching result of generations of interbreeding between neanderthals, wasters, and dirtmoles on the worst rimworlds humanity ever forgot. They're slow, ugly, and stink like a landfill, but thrive in toxic sludge and underground rot. Giant insects won't touch them, and half of them come out with genes from who-knows-where. No one's quite sure how they survive, but they do—much to everyone else's dismay.
This mod adds one new xenotype, 7 new genes (3 cosmetic), and a new faction.
[list] [*] [b]Insect allies:[/b] Trogs emit special pheromones that make giant insects recognize them as part of the hive. Insects won't attack them unless they attack first. That means they can easily tame insects - and Trog tribespeople will bring insects with them when assaulting your base. [*] [b]Mutants:[/b] The Trog genome is especially unstable, and every Trog has a chance to have a random extra gene. Sometimes they even have extra abilities like fire breath. Surprises can be fun, right? [*] [b]Stinking:[/b] Special glands located near a Trog's anus can release a cloud of toxic gas in an emergency, but look out - Trogs are resistant to environmental toxins, but not immune. [*] [b]Nasty, Brutish, and Short:[/b] The Trog genome is just loaded down with disadvantages, but somehow they work. No one knows how. Just don't expect them to take to advanced technology; rushing the enemy with clubs is much more their style.
